items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Turn More Cautious
items.snippet: PT cuts across RBC, BofA, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Mizuho, UBS, Argus on softer lithium sentiment and spot weakness. Bulls (Truist, Scotiabank, Argus, UBS, BofA, BMO) cite cost discipline and resilient demand. Mizuho cautious on China finished-product exports.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered PT to $135 from $230, keeps Buy. Lithium up ~67% y/y but well below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027; balance sheet solid, management reducing costs and conserving cash.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO cuts PT to $175 from $200, keeps Outperform; lowers lithium targets on spot weakness but views group as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand +45% through May, storage strong; supply lagging; inventories near record lows; $100M run-rate savings; outlook at high end of scenario ranges.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: ALB down 29.1% in six months as lithium prices fell on softer China EV demand, elevated inventory and mine restarts (e.g. Bald Hill).

items.headline: Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Tentative wage deal with Chilean union ahead of strike; member vote pending; averts prolonged supply disruption if ratified.
